fact: A May 2021 report states that registration of vital events in Eritrea is not a very common practice and that lack of institutional infrastructure at ground level leaves deficiencies in registering vital events, with a population register introduced from about 2003.
title: Access to Documents by Eritrean Refugees in the Context of Family Reunification
publisher: Equal Rights Beyond Borders and Immigration Advice Service (IRAP) / ecoi.net
